headline: Man United intend to appeal Leny Yoro red card against Liverpool - sources
description: Manchester United have notified the Football Association of their intention to appeal Leny Yoro's red card in the 4-0 defeat to Liverpool, sources have told ESPN.

headline: CAF president Patrice Motsepe hoping to keep AFCON in mid-year beyond 2027
description: CAF president Patrice Motsepe said he plans to keep the Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON) in the middle of the year beyond 2027 if possible, paving the way for players in Europe's top leagues to feature without clashing with league seasons.

headline: Dominik Szoboszlai labels Liverpool teammate Florian Wirtz 'world-class'
description: Dominik Szoboszlai has dubbed his Liverpool teammate Florian Wirtz "world-class" after his impressive display in Sunday's 4-0 victory over Manchester United.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: AC Milan to land Liverpool defender Virgil van Dijk?
description: AC Milan are monitoring the situation of Liverpool defender Virgil van Dijk. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Luca Williams-Barnett fell for under-21s joke before stellar Tottenham debut
description: Luca Williams-Barnett has revealed Tottenham boss Roberto De Zerbi joked he would be playing for the under-21s before he made his dazzling full debut in Saturday's 2-0 win over Ipswich.

headline: Kobbie Mainoo: 'No one's coming to save us' amid Man United crisis
description: Kobbie Mainoo warned "no one's coming to save us" as the Manchester United midfielder called for character and togetherness after the team reached the "lowest we've ever been".
